title: Project Library
desc: Browse, create, and manage your audiobook projects.
lede: The Library is your home base — every project lives here, ready to open or create.
body:
In progress — the Library is being refreshed as part of Phase 12; the shape below is the near-term target.
At a glance
  • Grid & list views with sorting.
  • Create a project with title, author, series, and cover.
  • Open or delete projects.

Browsing

See all your projects at a glance. Switch between grid and list views and sort to find what you need.

Creating a project

Create a project with its title, author, optional series, and a cover. These double as audiobook metadata at export time.

Opening & deleting

Open a project to enter its workspace (Project Workspace), or delete ones you no longer need.
